changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql: create or alter view graph.AssetNodeDisplayPath WITH SCHEMABINDING as select ID, Uid, Class, AssetTypeID, AssetTypeUid, Segments, graph.GetPath(Segments, ' > ', ' / ') as DisplayPath, State, UpdatedOn from graph.AssetNode

changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'CIX_GraphAssetNodeDisplayPath') BEGIN create unique clustered index CIX_GraphAssetNodeDisplayPath on graph.AssetNodeDisplayPath (ID) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_GraphAssetNodeDisplayPath_DisplayPath') BEGIN create nonclustered index IX_GraphAssetNodeDisplayPath_DisplayPath on graph.AssetNodeDisplayPath (DisplayPath) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_GraphAssetNodeDisplayPath_Uid') BEGIN create nonclustered index IX_GraphAssetNodeDisplayPath_Uid on graph.AssetNodeDisplayPath (Uid) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_GraphAssetNodeDisplayPath_AssetType') BEGIN create nonclustered index IX_GraphAssetNodeDisplayPath_AssetType on graph.AssetNodeDisplayPath (AssetTypeID asc) END
